name: Sensual Saga
detailed_description:
Welcome to Sensual Saga City!

Enter this open world full of fun, flirtation, and secrets. Meet charming women, enjoy wild parties, build playful connections, and dive into unforgettable summer adventures. Let yourself be swept away by the excitement, laughter, and freedom this universe has to offer!

Features
· Meet the girls of Sensual Saga and their stories — dare to be part of them
· Make friends… and maybe a few rivals. In love, anything goes
· Experience multiple storylines around a bustling university campus
· Help solve a mystery: who is the hooded figure stealing compromising photos of students
· Work hard, build strong bonds, and share intense moments of connection
· Who knows… maybe you’ll meet the girl of your dreams and win her over

Play as Jasper, a university student who learns that the girl he’s always dreamed of is transferring to another university at the end of the summer. Will you run into her at the same parties? Will you get your chance to win her over? What surprises—and people—will you encounter along the way? You might even uncover a mystery or two…

Add it to your wishlist now!
